build_bert_bpe_encoder: build a BertBPE encoder using a config with a custom vocab file or pretrained model
encode_text_with_bert_bpe: encode a string into BPE tokenized tokens using the BertBPE encode method
decode_bert_bpe_tokens: decode space-separated BPE tokens back into a cleaned string using the BertBPE decode method
check_beginning_of_word: check if a BPE token is the beginning of a word using the is_beginning_of_word method
configure_bert_bpe_cased: configure BertBPEConfig to use cased or uncased BPE tokenization with a custom vocab file
